title: Historical percentages after a genuine scope change
question: When planned scope genuinely changes (not an error correction), what happens to historical denominators and completion percentages?
context: Takeoff corrections must recalculate history (PROG-REQ-005), but the user explicitly deferred the policy for genuine scope changes. Neither code nor the correction policy answers it.
options: Recalculate history with the new scope
Keep history against the scope at the time
